summary: The design and design-review artifacts are internally consistent and fully aligned with the proposal, all three capability specs, the grill resolutions, and project context (CONSTITUTION/CONTEXT/ARCHITECTURE/ADR). The doctor report shape, x11-ewmh backend identity, root Rust 2021 package, Makefile wrappers, CODEX_DESKTOP_LINUX_FULL_PATH framing, registry fallback order, and sidecar/WindowObservationMeta boundary all match across files. No secret leakage (only variable names and a documented dev-machine default path appear). No model/effort policy issue is in scope for this stage. TDD discipline is respected: error-path RED evidence and stable bootstrap check names were correctly added. Two minor, non-blocking clarity concerns noted. Stage may proceed to ADR.
